items.label: KCC-12 — common wallet provider API + PSKB
items.note: EIP-1193/6963-style; overlaps the separate KIP-12 wallet-discovery effort — convergence is the open question

items.label: KCC-23 — MJ, JSON metadata bound to a covenant ID
items.note: now the metadata track: the rival KCC-21 proposal was closed as superseded on 2026-09-25, and a follow-up defining name/ticker/decimals/image fields is planned on top of KCC-23

items.label: KCC-20 — KCC-0 compliance + advancement to Last Call
items.note: the fungible-token standard moving toward finalization — KCC-0 (the process doc) itself went Final on 2026-09-21

items.label: Reputation, bond and identity registry covenant KCCs
items.note: a new proposal domain beyond tokens — registries as covenants; early draft

items.label: Argent KCC-20 reference implementation
items.note: the first real content in the official reference repo: a KCC-20 token actor, an admin-keyless public mint, offline examples — the kind of public implementation the standard needs before Final

items.label: Mobile wallet session & pairing API (draft, unnumbered)
items.note: companion territory to KCC-12's provider API — how a mobile wallet pairs with a dApp session; early draft
